what: the kink sheet (a kink pair on every chain, in register, at one site of the sequence) relaxed in the potential with the cell free, minus the all-trans cell named with it, relaxed there to the same stop, kcal/mol per kink pair; polyfind is the tables' value for the same site (examples/kink_site_scan.py). No DFT on these cells. kink_kept: every chain still has two gauche bonds of opposite sense about a trans one
all_trans: the first file of each pair
